operations.name: style.apply_preset
operations.description: Apply a layer-style preset (normalized v2 style; replaces the whole layer style, one undo step) to the active raster or text layer. Uses preset_id from preset.list(kind=style), or the active style preset.

preset_id.description: Style preset id; defaults to active style preset

operations.name: style.clear
operations.description: Layer > Layer Style > Clear Layer Style: remove every effect from the active layer as one undoable command. No-op (changed: false) when the layer has no style.

operations.name: style.get
operations.description: Read the layer style of the active raster or text layer (or layer_id) in the normalized v2 read-back shape: multi-instance arrays + single effects, WITHOUT the legacy singular mirror fields or the internal version marker — edit the result and pass it straight back to style.set. Also returns the document global light and whether any instance follows it.

layer_id.description: Target layer id — raster or text layer (default: active layer)

operations.name: style.save_preset
operations.description: Save the active layer's current layer style as a named style preset (same flow as the dialog's New Style…). The preset stores the normalized v2 style and becomes the active style preset. Errors when the layer has no style.

operations.name: style.scale
operations.description: Layer > Layer Style > Scale Effects: scale the active layer's style parameters (shadow/glow distances and sizes, stroke width, overlay scales) by a percentage. Colors, opacities, angles and spread/choke fractions are unchanged. One undo step.

operations.name: style.set
operations.description: Replace the ENTIRE layer style of the active raster or text layer (validated; empty/omitted clears — prefer style.clear for that). Round-trip: style.get -> edit -> style.set. v2 shape: multi-instance ARRAYS (index 0 = topmost of its kind) dropShadows, innerShadows, strokes, colorOverlays, gradientOverlays; single-instance outerGlow, innerGlow, bevelEmboss, satin, patternOverlay. v1 single-object fields (dropShadow, stroke, ...) are still accepted and migrate to arrays-of-one; when a plural array and its singular are both present the ARRAY wins. Every instance: enabled? bool, blendMode? (any layer blend mode; per-kind default), opacity 0..1. Shared shapes: color=[r,g,b 0..255]; contour={preset: linear|cone|coneInverted|coveDeep|coveShallow|gaussian|halfRound|ring|ringDouble|rollingSlope|sawtooth|custom, points? [{x,y} 0..1] (required for custom), antiAlias?}; stops=[{pos 0..1, color, alpha? 0..1}]; pattern payload={name, width, height, data flat RGBA bytes (width*height*4), patternId?}. Per kind: dropShadow{color, angle deg, useGlobalLight?, distance px, spread? 0..1, size px, contour?, antiAliased?, noise? 0..1, layerKnocksOut? default true}; innerShadow{color, angle, useGlobalLight?, distance, choke? 0..1, size, contour?, antiAliased?, noise?}; outerGlow{color, gradient? stops (replaces color as the source), size, technique? softer|precise, spread?, contour?, antiAliased?, noise?, range? 0..1, jitter? 0..1}; innerGlow{same + source? edge|center, choke? instead of spread}; bevelEmboss{style? outerBevel|innerBevel|emboss|pillowEmboss|strokeEmboss, technique? smooth|chiselHard|chiselSoft, depth? 0..10, direction? up|down, size, soften?, angle, useGlobalLight?, altitude? 0..90, glossContour?, glossAntiAliased?, highlightMode?/highlightColor?/highlightOpacity?, shadowMode?/shadowColor?/shadowOpacity?, contour? {enabled, curve?, antiAliased?, range? 0..1} (profile sub-effect), texture? {enabled, pattern?, scale? 1..1000, depth? -10..10, invert?, linkWithLayer?, origin? {x,y}}}; satin{color, angle, distance, size, contour?, antiAliased?, invert?}; stroke{color, size, position? outside|inside|center, fillType? color|gradient|pattern, gradient? {stops, angle, scale 1..1000, shape?, reverse?, offset?, method?, dither?}, pattern? {pattern payload, scale?, origin?}, overprint?}; colorOverlay{color}; gradientOverlay{stops, angle deg, scale 1..1000, shape? linear|radial|angle|reflected|diamond, reverse?, offset? {x,y percent}, dither?, alignWithLayer? default true, method? classic|linear|perceptual (smooth = classic)}; patternOverlay{name, width, height, data, scale 1..1000, origin {x,y}, angle?, linkWithLayer? default true}. Effects with useGlobalLight take the document light (style.set_global_light). Blend If / advanced blending are LAYER props (layer.set_props), not style fields. Malformed payloads are rejected with the offending field path.

effects.description: Layer style object (v2 arrays or v1 singles), or omit/{} to clear

operations.name: style.set_global_light
operations.description: Layer > Layer Style > Global Light: set the document-wide light {angle deg, altitude 0..90 deg} and update every effect instance with useGlobalLight (drop/inner shadows, bevel) across all layers. One undo step.

altitude.description: Light altitude 0..90 degrees (PS default 30); affects bevel only
